title: Main is red: the express-path tests fail on Windows because ci-scope.sh exits 1
why: Push run 43348145389 on main 36807ad19 (batch 113, #3041) failed 5 Windows merge jobs: the merge/test_merge.py ExpressPath tests (from #2985, step ruled-prose-express), where .github/scripts/ci-scope.sh exits 1 on Windows. The batch PR run passed. Runner 10 holds merges until main is green.
note: Fix lane session_013NEJKzMndrATd5V4pyEZoB, express. Open question: the batch PR run passed while the push run on main failed, so PR and push runs may gate different jobs. A batch can then merge green and turn main red. Find which Windows merge jobs the PR run skipped, and why; if the gating differs, file the gap as its own step.
